name: Suncatcher Blooms (3-4)

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-13: Within the Prairies

disable: DC 20 Survival check (trained) to safely move thorugh the flowers without activating the pollen.

items.name: Sedation
items.text:
Trigger A creature moves into the flowers' space.

---

Effect The pollen in the suncatcher blooms puffs out in a 5-foot burst. All creatures in the area must each attempt a DC 21 Fortitude save save.

---

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and is immune to the effects of suncatcher bloom pollen for 24 hours.

Success The creature is Stupefied 1 for 1 minute.

Failure The creature is Stupefied 1 for 1 hour and immediately falls unconscious. They do not fall prone or release what they are holding, and they can still wake up normally with a successful Perception check. If they are still unconscious after 1 minute they wake up automatically.

Critical Failure Same as failure, except the creature wakes up automatically after 1 hour instead of after 1 minute.

text: Bright, iridescent blue petals sprout from the cerulean center of this flower.
